description: This file defines a React functional component ConfirmDialog used as a modal dialog for user confirmations. It includes an internal hook useEscapeToClose for handling 'Escape' key to close the dialog, and manages overlay click events to dismiss the modal.

methods.name: useEscapeToClose(open, onCancel)
methods.description: A custom React hook that listens for the 'Escape' key press to trigger the onCancel callback when the dialog is open.

methods.name: ConfirmDialog({ open, title, message, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, onConfirm, onCancel })
methods.description: A React component rendering a confirmation modal dialog with title, message, confirm and cancel actions, and handling overlay clicks and escape key presses.
